Tee banner

2000 x 1000 mm

The supplied template: landscape, 30 mm sewn binding down each short edge. Front and back print as one double-sided banner.

Pull-up banner

850 x 2000 mm

Cassette roll-up for a clubhouse evening or an expo stand. Nothing lands in the bottom 260 mm.

Course A-frames

900 x 1200 and 600 x 900 mm

Rigid panels read from a cart at ten metres or more. Print any two faces back to back: lockup on the approach side, download on the side golfers wait on.

A-frame message faces

900 x 1200 mm

One sentence and nothing else, for a frame that is there to say a single thing rather than introduce the brand. Every claim on these was checked against the shipped app first.

More than a scorecard

The comparison campaign

Comparative artwork aimed at the category SwingTribe competes with, which is apps that capture a card and stop there. The left column names a category and never a product, because a claim about what a scoring app does can be checked against any listing in either store, and a rival name printed two metres wide cannot be taken back off.
